newsitem.title: USA: Gabelli group to not back Media election.
newsitem.headline: Gabelli group to not back Media election.

text.p: A group led by New York investment manager Mario Gabelli said Friday it does not plan at this time to support the election of the proposed Media General Inc board of directors at the next annual meeting.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its lack of support is the result of Media's failure to enhance shareholder value.
The group said it may also contact other shareholders to discuss its voting and concerns with respect to the company.
The group holds a 25.74 percent stake in the company, or 6,707,800 shares.
The company, based in Richmond, Va., publishes daily and Sunday newspapers, network-affiliated television stations and cable television franchises.
